top_violation_types.title: HRC42.052(d) - Illegal Operation - Not Registered (26 TAC §HRC42.052(d) - Illegal Operation - Not R)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There were 5 unrelated children found in care at the time of inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - More Than 5 Years Experience (26 TAC §747.1309(e)(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The primary caregiver needed one additional hour of training in management techniques, leadership, or staff supervision.

top_violation_types.title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §747.5005(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The caregiver did not practice fire drill monthly since 01/2022.

top_violation_types.title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §747.3501)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A propane tank was observed in an outdoor area accessible to children.

top_violation_types.title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training -30 Hours Required (26 TAC §747.1309(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There were no annual training hours available for viewing.

top_violation_types.title: Administering Medication - Original Container with Child's Name, Date (26 TAC §746.3805(b)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Medication was not kept or stored in the original container for a child in care.

top_violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Notarized affidavit was missing on file for one out of four staff files checked.

top_violation_types.title: Documentation of Drills (26 TAC §746.5205(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Re-cite: Documentation of drills was not available for review at the time of inspection.
